claim_text: The September 17, 2025 indictment in United States v. Aden et al., No. 0:25-cr-00349 (ECF 1), alleges that between approximately May 2023 and April 2025 Foundation First Services LLC, operated by defendant Abdifitah Mohamud Mohamed, submitted reimbursement claims totaling about $222,000. That is an amount_billed charging allegation for a second provider, not proven_loss, and it is not a Falade figure.
